infographic.title: Noncontact Level Measurement
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how radar vs ultrasonic level measurement works using time of flight
steps: The sensor sends a sound pulse (ultrasonic) or microwave pulse (radar) down to the surface.
The pulse reflects from the liquid or solid surface back to the sensor.
The sensor measures the travel time and calculates the distance.
Tank height minus distance gives level, sent as 4 to 20 mA or HART.
